title: 48 Geoff Wilder | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool and Beach Just Steps Away- 48 Geoff Wilder by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 48 Geoff Wilder by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach South of 30A Address: 48 Geoff Wilder Lane Details: Look no further for your prime dream vacation! 48 Geoff Wilder, formerly Grits Carlton, is located in the exclusive gated gulf-front community of Water’s Edge. This beach front community, borders Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach along the highly desirable Scenic Highway 30A. The four-bedroom four bath home has been remodeled with all new décor throughout including outdoor furnishings on the expansive porches and the beautiful lanai. Take full advantage of the largest private pool in Water’s Edge and perhaps all of 30A. When it is time for the beach, stroll the palm tree-lined pedestrian path that leads to the neighborhood’s private beach walkover. With only 26 home-sites and security gate, Water’s Edge has almost no car traffic. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Private Beach Access: 400 Feet (2 Minute Walk) -Parking Spaces: 2 in Driveway -Gated Community -Outdoor Shower -Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Firepit and Chair Set -Beach Towel Service -Private Heated Pool: *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 13 4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed and Twin Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 2: Two Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: Two Bunk Beds with Detached Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Great Room with Kitchen, Dining Living, Expansive Balconies with Outdoor Living, Views Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower), Balcony, Views Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – November Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *There is a pool alarm located at the main entrance of the home. *The indoor fireplace is not available for guest use. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
